summary: Oaktree Strategic Credit Fund filed an 8-K disclosing a routine monthly distribution declaration and NAV update. The board declared distributions of $0.16 per share across Class I, D, S, and T shares, payable to shareholders of record July 29, 2026, with payment around August 27, 2026. NAV per share as of June 30, 2026 was $22.32 (down from $22.41 in May), aggregate NAV about $4.3 billion, portfolio fair value $6.8 billion, and leverage ratio 0.58x. The filing also notes a continuous public offering up to $5.0 billion. These are ordinary operational disclosures, not a special-situation event.
